about: Refreshed by heavenly nourishment, the community asks that through Angela Merici’s prayers and example it may be cleansed from every stain and please God in both body and mind.

seg.tr: Refreshed by heavenly nourishment, Lord, we humbly entreat You that, cleansed from every stain through blessed Angela’s prayers and example, we may please You in both body and mind. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

ex.w003: The praying community has been refreshed by heavenly nourishment and now addresses God.
ex.w007: This deponent form means that we entreat God. Its passive-looking ending does not make the community the object of someone else’s entreaty.
ex.w010: The heading identifies Angela Merici. Both the prayers and the example belong to her.
ex.w013: Angela’s prayers and example accompany the requested cleansing and pleasing. Their contribution can be understood across the whole requested sequence.
ex.w017: Cleansing is presented as the resulting state in which we are to please God. The participle does not by itself say that this requested cleansing was complete before the prayer was spoken.
ex.w021: With placeámus, the dative tibi identifies God as the one to whom we ask to be pleasing. The petition includes both body and mind.
ex.w031: The relative subject is the Son named immediately before. He lives and reigns with the Father whom the prayer addresses.
ex.w032: Tecum combines the second-person pronoun with cum: with You. The Father remains the addressee.
ex.w038: The genitive names the Holy Spirit. No additional “same” is supplied.
ex.w040: This nominative identifies the Son as God. It is not a new vocative or a change of addressee.
